rounding.note: Java ConvexJointArbitrator.parseResult uses Math.round per cell (line ~355). Independent cellwise rounding of a feasible continuous allocation can push a column sum above capacity.

negative_consumption.note: RealisticAgentFramework.tryConsumeResource (lines ~694-711): a negative amount satisfies 'amount <= remaining' and is added to consumed, so recorded consumption DECREASES from 40 to 10.
